ios.desc:
"Learning Japanese Through Life"

On my journey to learn Japanese, I deeply understand the challenge of memorizing words - learning and forgetting, wanting to speak but unable to start.
As a learner who relies on visual memory techniques, I know the power of visualizing abstract concepts.
This experience inspired the idea of "integrating Japanese into life, learning Japanese through life" - this is the original intention behind developing this app.

KaChika 勝ち〜カ

# Smart Image Analysis

We analyze image content to generate multiple words and create everyday sentences based on these words.
Word tags on images are clickable with pronunciation features, making them incredibly convenient learning companions.

# Flashcards - Smart Learning System

Master Japanese vocabulary effortlessly with our intelligent spaced repetition system. Our flashcards adapt to your learning pace, automatically scheduling reviews when you need them most.

Smart Scheduling: Powered by forgetting curve algorithms to optimize your review timing

Progress Tracking: Visual insights into your learning journey

Efficient Learning: Focus on what you need to review, not what you already know

# Share Cards

You can save your created images to your album for easy access and share them on any social media platform.
View all words at a glance and learn vocabulary based on different scenarios.

# History Review

Making a card sends the photo for AI analysis; your cards and study history then live on the device — no account, no cloud library.
Through history, we can easily review word cards for repeated learning sessions.

I hope this app can help learners who share similar struggles, enabling us to master Japanese effortlessly in our daily lives!

# Membership Service

The membership service auto-renews within 24 hours of the expiration date. If you plan to cancel your subscription, you can do so within 24 hours before expiration to prevent auto-renewal.

android.desc:
Learn Japanese from the things around you.

KaChiKa turns everyday photos into Japanese vocabulary cards. Take a picture of a room, meal, sign, or street scene, and the app helps you find useful words, check pronunciation, read example sentences, and review them later.

Learn from photos

See Japanese words on the image, tap a tag to hear pronunciation, and read a short example sentence. Real scenes make vocabulary easier to remember than isolated word lists.

Review with flashcards

Save words as cards and review them with spaced repetition. KaChiKa brings cards back when they are due, so you can spend more time on the words that need attention.

- Spaced review based on the forgetting curve
- Progress view for learned and due cards
- Context-rich cards from your own photos

Save and share

Keep generated cards in your album, revisit them anytime, or share them with friends.

Private by design

Your saved image history stays on your device. KaChiKa does not upload your image history.

Subscription renews automatically unless canceled before the end of the current period.
Terms of Use: https://kachika.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kachika.app/privacy

quotes.text:
I'm both a Japanese learner and an indie developer. Throughout my journey of learning Japanese (currently living in Japan), I've deeply felt the challenge of memorizing words — learning them only to forget, wanting to speak but finding myself tongue-tied.

Why I Made This
As someone who relies heavily on visual memory, I understand the power of turning abstract concepts into visual forms. You know that feeling when you're walking around and spot something interesting — maybe a beautiful seasonal poster, a curious shop name, or even just a package design that catches your eye? Those little moments of curiosity that make you think "I wish I could remember these words!"... That was exactly my experience

This experience inspired a simple yet powerful idea: "Learn Japanese through life, live with Japanese" — and that became the heart and soul of this app: Kachika (カチカ).

Turn Your Daily Discoveries into Learning Moments
Kachika helps you learn Japanese naturally through your everyday life:

Capture What You See Just snap a photo of anything interesting in your daily life

Instant Learning Words are detected automatically with native pronunciation

Your Personal Collection Build vocabulary that matters to you, all stored privately on device

Fun fact about the name "Kachika" (カチカ):

カチッ (the sound of taking a photo)

勝ち (kachi - victory/success)

か (ka - that soft Japanese particle that makes everything sound nicer!)
